## Pull request overview This PR enhances the admin user management experience by (1) isolating/admin-filtering users by `examType`, (2) adding an admin-generated, time-limited “set password” link flow, and (3) surfacing more user metadata + password status/actions directly in the user list UI. **Changes:** - Add `examType` to the admin users API payload and filter the list to `examType='mppsc'`. - Introduce `generateManualPasswordLink(userId)` admin server action that inserts a `verification_tokens` record and returns a set-password URL. - Update the admin users UI to display additional metadata (created date, user ID, exam type, source, IP), show a password status badge, and provide a one-click “copy set-password link” action for inactive users. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/app/api/admin/users/route.ts` | Adds `examType` to returned user data and filters results to MPPSC users. | | `src/actions/admin-actions.ts` | Implements manual password link generation via `verification_tokens` + `appPath('auth/set-password')`. | | `src/app/admin/users/UsersClient.tsx` | Adds UI for password status + creation metadata and integrates the manual link generator with clipboard copy. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1) **src/app/admin/users/UsersClient.tsx:805** * The “Manual Password Link” action is shown for any inactive (non-deleted) user. Given that the set-password flow can also activate a subscription, it would be safer to additionally gate this action to the intended cohort (e.g., users with a non-free plan / users with a captured payment) and/or add an explicit confirmation that this link can activate the account. ``` )} {/* Toggle active */}
